items.title: 14.4.1 Oxides of carbon (carbon ke oxides) (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 14.4.1, printed page 308.

blocks.text: Carbon ke do oxides hain: carbon monoxide (CO) aur carbon dioxide (CO₂).
Carbon monoxide (CO) zyada tar fossil fuels ke incomplete combustion (poora na jalna, yani kam oxygen mein jalna) se banti hai:

blocks.title: Did You Know? (kya aap jante hain)
blocks.text: Carbon monoxide bohat poisonous (zehreeli) gas hai; saans ke saath andar jaye to suffocation (dam ghutna) hota hai. Yeh khoon ke hemoglobin ke saath oxygen se zyada zor se jur jati hai, is liye oxygen normal respiration (saans) mein kaam nahi aa pati. Zyada pressure wali oxygen de kar CO poisoning (zehar) ka asar khatam kiya ja sakta hai.

Carbon dioxide sab se important greenhouse gas hai jo human kaamon, jaise fossil fuels jalane, se hawa mein aati hai. CO₂ ek primary greenhouse gas hai jo atmosphere mein traps heat (garmi rok leti hai), aur is se global warming hoti hai:

blocks.caption: Carbon ke oxides
rows: hemoglobin se jurti hai, dam ghut-ta hai; ilaj: zyada pressure wali oxygen

blocks.prompt: Kaun si aam human activity hawa mein carbon monoxide barhati hai, aur CO thori amount mein bhi khatarnak kyun hai?
blocks.explanation: Petrol (gasoline) se chalne wali gariyan, jin ke engines fuel poori tarah nahi jalate. CO is liye khatarnak hai ke hemoglobin ise oxygen se kahin zyada zor se pakarta hai; thori CO bhi khoon ki oxygen le jane ki ability rok deti hai.

items: Incomplete combustion se CO (2C + O₂ → 2CO): hemoglobin se jur kar zehar ka kaam karti hai.
Complete combustion se CO₂ (C + O₂ → CO₂): garmi rokne wali primary greenhouse gas.
